generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure uploading of all relevant documents specified in Bid Document

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All conditions in the bid documents are applicable

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have satisfactorily completed at least one AMC work of computers and LAN systems as a primary contractor, with a value not less than Rs. 8.44 Lakhs in Government Organizations / Public Sector Undertakings / Reputed Organizations during the preceding five financial years (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). The bidder shall submit a copy of the Work Order and the corresponding Work Done Certificate issued by the competent authority. A weightage of 10% per year shall be given to the works completed in previous years to bring them to the present price level of the current financial year.

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder should have achieved an average annual financial turnover of at least Rs. 16.88 Lakhs in any two financial years during the preceding five financial years (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). The bidder must furnish copies of the turnover certificates duly certified by a Chartered Accountant. A weightage of 10% per year shall be given to the financial turnover of previous years to bring it to the present price level of the current financial year
